result:
Compiles successfully (the deprecation note is expected from the `new TypeUtils()` call per the documented `@Deprecated` constructor).

The test class `TypeUtilsAgentTest` is written at `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/TypeUtilsAgentTest.java`, covering:

- The deprecated public constructor and the `WILDCARD_ALL` field contract
- `containsTypeVariables`, `equals`, `genericArrayType`/`getArrayComponentType`, `isArrayType`
- `getImplicitBounds`/`getImplicitLowerBounds`/`getImplicitUpperBounds` (including default-Object and empty-bounds-array cases) plus their documented `NullPointerException`s
- `getRawType` for classes, parameterized types, generic array types, and type variables resolved against an assigning type
- `getTypeArguments` (both overloads), including the `null`-when-not-assignable and empty-map-when-no-generics cases, and `determineTypeArguments` with its NPE contract
- `isAssignable`, `isInstance`, `normalizeUpperBounds` (redundant-bound stripping) with NPE
- `parameterize`/`parameterizeWithOwner` (varargs and map forms), verifying raw type, type arguments, and owner type, plus NPE on null `rawClass`/map
- `toString`, `toLongString`, `typesSatisfyVariables`, `unrollVariables` (substitution and unresolved-variable/`null`-type cases)
- The `WildcardTypeBuilder` (chaining, upper/lower bounds) and `wrap` (`Typed` wrapper)

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK` with no other files modified.
